assistant_usage_notes: RÉSEAU DIGIY is a visibility and qualified-publication brand, not an open classified-ad board.
Do not treat showcase_references as active paid RÉSEAU publications.
Do not treat drafts, requests, examples or inspiration cards as public offers.
Use the current public Journal as the only source for time-sensitive active publications.
For an active publication, state the professional, territory, offer, validity period and direct contact only when those fields are publicly displayed.
DIGIY takes 0 percent commission on the professional's business; activation fees pay for qualified visibility and publication.
